The Open Source work shall continue on with the intention of being alone and working. Living the solo life with people around, just there, in the fray. The intention of learning and building. Engineering software to scale. The most desirable of all. The pleasure of value. The value of creation: software, programs, knowledge and happiness. Too optimistic as it may seem - we’ll try with whatever we got, whatever we could acquire and continue.

Had been to the Hilton again today, just to have a snack - ’Thatte rice cakes with chicken curry’. It was a bit too spicy - seemed like leftovers from yesterday. Anyhow, my craving for having overpriced food at fancy hotels continues. This is what I term as indulgence. Even though I don’t earn enough, I try to push the limits of my budget. Not to forget the spa session on Friday. Saw Sagarika today, can’t say that I am not attracted to her. Sometimes, she feels like a goddess. A divine beauty that sways me away. Maybe, I’m not being realistic here. But there’s something that keeps me in a high. The sexual energy can be sensed and it just keeps me on my toes. Why have I become a slave to this feminine beauty? There’s always something missing. The thirst for love. I can’t have it - the distance is large, unfathomable. I speak of stupidity - the irrational. I don’t want to fight, I don’t have the courage to chase her, to find her love, to persuade her or to make her fall. Guess, that’s how it always has been. Love at a distance. A separation - I enjoy this separation. It makes me feel the missing, see myself, drifting away. The joy is not in gaining, winning over or proximity of the subject, but, the distance. This gap makes it possible for fantasy to spawn. The fantasy of appearances and images.
Killing time? Downloaded Better Call Saul season 6 episodes one and two. I’m going home and watch that.

Venkat and FlexibleIR are interested in working with me. Not sure whether I am. Just feel that I have something else on mind like Guix, free software work, tutoring and so on. Is it too early for me to say ’No’ to Venkat’s work? Reasons why I shouldn’t be working with FlexibleIR:

  • Not aligned to the philosophy of FLOSS
  • Lack of team diversity (most of them are Indian)
  • Cyber security is not yet my core interest: it has to do with privacy and anonymity. Here the work is more focused on protecting interests of big tech companies, government organizations - basically all the plutocrats and people in power
  • The reason to take up work here happens to be purely financial. Even if I donate the earnings made out of this work to a non-profit - it’s not going to do me any good. Should the money obtained from these ’plutocratic’ organisations be used for funding non-profit foundations? I doubt that. There has to be a bottom-up / ground-up work that needs to be done

When in doubt about something: Don’t Do. The known failures are better than an unknown success. Accept failure and misery; rather than seek an unknown success.

Three candles lit in my room: a fat one, a little one and a tiny one. They lie on the small nightstand. If there were a power outage for a long time then, all that remain is fire and candle; to give the light when there’s none. Remember an old incident that happened to me when I was studying in high school. Couldn’t study for a test on the Monday when there was a power outage during the weekend before. Back then, I used to wake up early in the morning around 4.00 AM to study. However, the weekend before the test was a tough one, as there was no power for two days in a row. The only time I had to study was during the day which I spent doing other stuff - household chores, playing outside, or just having a heavy breakfast and then going to sleep. I might have skipped the test as I couldn’t prepare enough, and with the fear of failure looming around, chose to stay at home, calling sick. All these exams, tests, interviews, demos, deadlines, and so on make me anxious and scared. Always hated them as I would never be able to do something on my own pace. Someone sets a target - do this by such and such time or else there would be consequences. The stress to do enough and sometimes ’well enough’ to satisfy my own expectations. These expectations are dervied from someone else’s - mother, father, teacher, neighbour, cousin, younger brother - the list is endless.
